description: This file contains functions and setup procedures for configuring, renewing, and tearing down DHCPv6 protocol in OpenWrt, including initialization, configuration, and command execution logic.

methods.name: proto_dhcpv6_add_prefix
methods.description: Appends a prefix to a list of prefixes.

methods.name: proto_dhcpv6_add_sendopts
methods.description: Adds send options to the DHCPv6 configuration.

methods.name: proto_dhcpv6_setup
methods.description: Sets up DHCPv6 configuration and executes the DHCPv6 client.

methods.name: proto_dhcpv6_teardown
methods.description: Kills DHCPv6 process for the interface.
